title: "Codebook"
---

## 2026 JIDS article

### `isaac_cases`

One row per arbitration.

| Variable | Description | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `case_id` | ISAAC case identifier | integer |
| `case_name` | Short case name, from UNCTAD | string |
| `year_init` | Year the arbitration was initiated | integer |
| `year_incid` | Year of the first alleged treaty breach | integer |
| `sector` | Economic sector of the investment: Primary, Secondary, or Tertiary | string |
| `outcome` | Case outcome, original UNCTAD coding | string |
| `outcome_2023` | Case outcome, UNCTAD 31 December 2023 release | string |
| `prop_award` | Damages awarded divided by damages claimed, in USD | numeric |
| `domestic_suit` | 1 if the investor pursued domestic litigation before ISDS | 0/1 |
| `indir_exp_alleged` | 1 if the investor alleged indirect expropriation | 0/1 |
| `gdp_capita` | Respondent GDP per capita in the incident year, USD | numeric |
| `v2x_rule` | Respondent V-Dem rule of law index in the incident year | numeric |
| `no_public_docs` | 1 if no case documents are publicly available | 0/1 |

### `isaac_redactions`

One row per arbitration with processable public documents.

| Variable | Description | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `arbitration_id` | Redaction pipeline case identifier | string |
| `case_id` | ISAAC case identifier; blank if unmatched | integer |
| `year` | Year the arbitration was initiated | integer |
| `mean_coverage_percent` | Mean share of document text redacted, 0 to 100 | numeric |
| `total_inline` | Redactions of a word or short phrase | integer |
| `total_partial_line` | Redactions of part of a line | integer |
| `total_full_line` | Redactions of a full line | integer |
| `total_block` | Redactions of a paragraph or larger | integer |

### `unctad_awards_2023`

One row per case in UNCTAD's Investment Dispute Settlement Navigator, 31 December 2023 release.

| Variable | Description | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `unctad_no` | UNCTAD case number | integer |
| `case_name` | Short case name | string |
| `year_init` | Year the arbitration was initiated | integer |
| `outcome` | Case outcome | string |
| `claims` | Damages claimed, USD millions | numeric |
| `awards` | Damages awarded, USD millions | numeric |
| `prop_award` | `awards` divided by `claims` | numeric |
